title: The Paper Reviewing Process is Now in Critical Condition [D]
summary: TL;DR: AI written reviews, and AI-writing in papers I was going to give this a title "An Obituary of the Review Process", but in the interest of not sounding too defeatist, I will just say "Critical Condition" because of AI writing, both on the author side and the reviewer side.
reason: Reddit discussion/commentary post about AI-written reviews harming peer review. No new research artifact, paper link, model release, business event, policy action, or OSS tool; no rule covers commentary.
